# Lis Luxury Salón Spa

> Nails, brows & lashes based in Pflugerville, Texas. A luxury beauty salon on Spring Hill Ln in Pflugerville: sculpted sets, French tips and nail art, pedicures, brows and lash extensions, with fresh coffee and good conversation while you're pampered.

- Phone: (512) 785-1109
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Austin, Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch, Manor
- Google rating: 5.0 from 105 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/lis-luxury-sal-n-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/lis-luxury-sal-n-spa/book.html

## Services
- Sculpted sets: Long, glossy acrylic and gel sets shaped to you, from deep burgundy chrome to soft nudes.
- Nail art: 3D flowers, gold details and hand-painted designs for when you want something special.
- French tips: Crisp, clean French tips, from classic white to soft and natural.
- Pedicures: Relax in a mint pedicure chair and leave with smooth feet and a fresh, glossy colour.
- Brows: Brows shaped to suit your face. Clients ask for Marle by name.
- Lash extensions: Soft, full lash extensions that open up the eyes.

## About
Lis Luxury Salón Spa sits in Suite 113 at 15608 Spring Hill Ln in Pflugerville. Inside: mint pedicure chairs on gold frames, warm oak floors, a wall of red roses and the gold LS logo glowing on a curved wall. The salon opened with a ribbon cutting under a sage, cream and gold balloon arch, and it has since earned a 5.0 rating from 105 Google reviews. Nails, pedicures, brows and lashes are all done here, so you can book everything in one visit. Clients describe it as clean, welcoming and relaxing, with a professional, talented team, plenty of laughter and conversation, and delicious coffee. They mention Marle for brows and Annaly by name.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., Tuesday to Saturday 9 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. Closed Sunday. Call (512) 785-1109 to book.
- Q: Where is the salon?
  A: Suite 113 at 15608 Spring Hill Ln, Pflugerville, TX 78660.
- Q: What services do you offer?
  A: Acrylic and gel sets, French tips, nail art, pedicures, brows and lash extensions, all in one salon.
- Q: Can I book nails and brows or lashes in the same visit?
  A: Yes. Everything is under one roof, so you can combine services. Mention it when you book so we can plan your time.
- Q: Can I bring an inspiration photo?
  A: Please do. Photos help us plan your set or nail art before you sit down.
